title: Arrival cadence and alternate routing for Horizon Systems onsite workshop
text:
Arrival cadence and alternate routing for Horizon Systems onsite workshop

["From: Katherine D'Souza <katherine.dsouza@horizon-systems.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Cc: purchasing@horizon-systems.com
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Arrival window and potential rebook for Horizon onsite (26 Jul)

Hi Vivek / team,

Quick note from our side — the workshop on Thu 26 Jul kicks off at 08:30 in Palo Alto (Horizon HQ). A few of our execs have flights landing around 07:50 which leaves little buffer for ground transfer and check-in. TravelOps flagged limited seat availability on the morning flights, but they can get earlier options that land by 06:45 with a modest fare difference.

Would Redwood be able to approve switching the three visiting execs to the earlier routing? If so, please confirm and well have TravelOps prepare rebook stubs and any PO needed. Attendee list attached for reference.

Thanks —
Katherine D'Souza
Program Lead, Strategic Partnerships
Horizon Systems

Attachments: Horizon_Workshop_Attendee_List_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)
", "From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Katherine D'Souza <katherine.dsouza@horizon-systems.com>, Emma Park <emma.park@travelops.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Arrival window and potential rebook for Horizon onsite (26 Jul)

Thanks Katherine — appreciate the heads up.

Were fine with moving folks earlier to give a reliable cushion before the 08:30 start. Emma (TravelOps) — can you please: 1) propose the alternate flights and show the delta per passenger, 2) flag any non-refundable fares, and 3) include the current PNRs so we can check for overlap?

Lauren and Marcus: confirming you both are OK with an earlier arrival (~06:45 landing). If you prefer to keep your current legs, let us know asap. Monica — if there are any budget constraints I should sign off on, flag them here; otherwise I can approve up to $450 incremental per passenger for rebookings.

If Emma sends stubs, please include a quick timeline for ground pickup so I can coordinate with our onsite team.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
", "From: Emma Park <emma.park@travelops.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, Katherine D'Souza <katherine.dsouza@horizon-systems.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 13:44:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed alternate routings + PNR stubs (Horizon workshop, 26 Jul)

Hi all,

Per Viveks request, attached are two rebooking options for the three execs. Option A keeps the same carrier with an earlier leg (1 stop, lands SFO 06:35) — delta $210/passenger. Option B is a nonstop on a different carrier (lands SFO 06:45) — delta $360/passenger. Both include 1 carry-on + standard seat selection; upgraded seats available at extra cost.

Current PNRs (existing):
 - LIN-MARCUS: PNR ABC123 (original arrival 07:48)
 - BISH-LAUREN: PNR DEF456 (original arrival 08:05)
 - GUP-RAJ: PNR GHI789 (external attendee)

Proposed provisional stubs (attached): PNR_PROPOSED_3781.pdf — contains flight times, connection notes, and estimated rebook fee. If Redwood confirms, we will process rebookings and issue final PNRs; rebook charges will be billed to the PO on file unless otherwise directed.

Please reply with either APPROVE OPTION A, APPROVE OPTION B, or HOLD. If approving, indicate any seat/frequent-flyer details to add to the reservations.

Thanks,
Emma Park
Senior Account Manager, TravelOps

Attachments: PNR_PROPOSED_3781.pdf (travel stubs)", 'From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Park <emma.park@travelops.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed alternate routings + PNR stubs (Horizon workshop, 26 Jul)

APPROVE OPTION A for me and Marcus. Marcus: please add my FF# NQ34567 and seat preference aisle window (I can take either).

Marcus: also confirm if you want business or economy with an aisle.

- Lauren
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
', 'From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Park <emma.park@travelops.com>, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed alternate routings + PNR stubs (Horizon workshop, 26 Jul)

Thanks — APPROVE OPTION A for me as well. Please add my FF# UA98123 and request an aisle seat if possible. Im okay with standard economy; keep upgrades optional and let me know price.

Emma: once rebooked, confirm final PNRs and pickup ETA to Horizon HQ so I can forward to my assistant.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference
', "From: Emma Park <emma.park@travelops.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: Katherine D'Souza <katherine.dsouza@horizon-systems.com>, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Jul 2028 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finalized rebookings + final PNRs (Horizon workshop)

All — rebookings completed as APPROVE OPTION A. Final PNRs and timelines below:

 - Marcus Lin: PNR ZYX452 (arrive SFO 06:35, ground pickup 07:10 at Terminal 3 curb A)
 - Lauren Bishop: PNR ZYX453 (arrive SFO 06:35, same pickup)
 - Guest (Gupraj): PNR ZYX454 (arrive SFO 06:35)

Rebook delta charged: $210 x 3 = $630 (invoiced to PO #HS-2028-07). Non-refundable fare rules noted in each PNR. Attached: PNR_FINAL_4529.pdf (final stubs).

If anyone needs a receipt or seat change, reply with the PNR and request.

Safe travels —
Emma Park
Senior Account Manager, TravelOps

Attachments: PNR_FINAL_4529.pdf (finalized itineraries)"]
